_note: Static catalogue of published 3D models for amitkuzi.github.io. Hand-maintained — nothing is fetched from MakerWorld or Printables at build or run time, by design. Publish a model, add a row here, redeploy.
_rules: NO engagement counts. Downloads, likes and views go stale the moment this file is written, and a stale '2 downloads' reads worse than no number at all. If a number is ever wanted, it belongs on the platform page, not here.
One model = one entry, even when it is published on several platforms. 'links' is an array so the same design can carry a MakerWorld and a Printables URL without being duplicated.
'thumb' is a LOCAL path. Download the platform thumbnail into ./assets/models/ and commit it — hotlinking a platform CDN breaks when they rotate URLs, and it leaks a referrer.
'tool' links a model back to the app that generated it. That link is the whole point: it is what turns a 3D-model listing into evidence of software engineering.
